ITEM 1 | Strawberries, four to five halves and one whole-looking piece, bright red with pale seeded surface, glossy and moist, halves about 3 to 4 cm long, sitting at the top and right of the plate | 60
ITEM 2 | Blueberries, about 10 small dark blue-black spheres, about 1 cm diameter each, smooth and slightly glossy, clustered at upper center and right of the plate | 15
ITEM 3 | Cooked sweet potato cubes, orange with caramelized browned edges and some darker charred spots, firm and slightly dry-looking surface, pieces roughly 1.5 to 2.5 cm cubes, scattered in a loose pile in the lower center of the plate | 110
ITEM 4 | Bacon strips, cooked, reddish-brown with darker crisp edges, flat thin slices about 0.2 cm thick and 8 to 10 cm long, lying in a curved arrangement on the right side of the plate near the strawberries | 45
ITEM 5 | Small smear of pinkish-red juice or sauce, thin and watery, faint streaks across the upper center of the plate near the strawberries | 5
